_about: The 24 printed guides (Release 7, D783): each made by tools/build_manuals.py from content already in the repository. A source is one of: page:<file> (a whole page; its title becomes a section), page:<file>#<Heading>|<Heading> (only those ## sections), howdoi:pages=<a>,<b> (those How do I pages, in that order), howdoi:group=<Group>[;role=<role>] (every How do I page of that group, for that role), help:sections=<Section>|<Section> or help:commands=<name>,<name> (the eax command's own help), new:<file> (content written for the guides, docs/manuals/new). Every guide gets a cover, About this guide (its purpose, who it is for, how to use it) and a table of contents.

manuals.title: Overview: capabilities and roles
manuals.audience: Everyone: sponsors, architects, administrators and developers
manuals.purpose: What EA Explorer is, what it does, how it follows the TOGAF Standard, and who does what in it: the kinds of people who use it, the roles they hold and what each role may do. Read it first; every other guide builds on it.

manuals.title: System architecture and platform developer guide
manuals.audience: Platform developers who change EA Explorer itself, and architects who review how it is built
manuals.purpose: How EA Explorer is built (its containers, services, databases and code layout) and how a developer gets the code, runs it, changes it, tests it and releases it.

manuals.title: Install guide
manuals.audience: System administrators installing EA Explorer on a laptop or a server
manuals.purpose: Everything needed to put EA Explorer on a machine and have it running: the choices (laptop, server, your own database), the machine to prepare, the installation itself, your certificate on the front door, and the first-run setup.

chapters.title: Installing
sources: page:docs/deployment.md#1. Get EA Explorer (no repository needed)|2. The wizard: `eax deploy`|Check your installation|On a container platform (R2.44, D635)

manuals.title: System administrator guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins, IT Admins and User Admins
manuals.purpose: Running the installation: people and their roles, security, settings, branding, machine access and the system's own configuration, with a step-by-step How do I for every task.

manuals.title: Day-to-day operations guide
manuals.audience: IT Admins and Super Admins who keep EA Explorer running
manuals.purpose: The everyday work of keeping EA Explorer healthy: starting and stopping, health and alerts, logs, backups, the job queue, the command centre and schedules, with a step-by-step How do I for each task.

chapters.title: Everyday commands
sources: page:docs/operations.md#Everyday commands|How EA Explorer starts (phase 12.1, D255)|The work folder and logs|Services on and off (D191)|The operations helper

manuals.title: Tuning and optimisation guide
manuals.audience: IT Admins and Super Admins sizing and tuning an installation
manuals.purpose: Sizing a new installation, measuring how it runs, the optimisation report and its suggestions, more API and job servers, scaling out, and keeping the databases in good order.

chapters.title: More servers and scaling out
sources: page:docs/operations.md#API and job servers (D249)|Scaling out (phase 36.3, D520, D521, D526 to D528)

manuals.title: Administrator guide for models
manuals.audience: Model Admins
manuals.purpose: Looking after models: creating them, their metamodels, who may work on them, versions, tags and merging, data quality, and the model wizards, with a step-by-step How do I for each task.

manuals.title: Administrator guide for projects
manuals.audience: Project Admins
manuals.purpose: Setting up and running architecture projects: kinds of projects, templates and bases, the ADM cycle, charters, people, governance, deliverables and sign-off, surveys and maturity, with a step-by-step How do I for each task.

manuals.title: Architects' guide
manuals.audience: Practising architects
manuals.purpose: The everyday work of an architect in EA Explorer: finding and changing content, committing it, views and reports, bringing data in and taking it out, stakeholders and key questions, and working in projects, with a step-by-step How do I for each task.

chapters.title: Bringing data in and taking it out

manuals.title: Industry expert guide: making an industry model
manuals.audience: Industry modellers who build reference models for an industry
manuals.purpose: How to make an industry model: the metamodel, building it in Excel, the industry packs, and publishing it as a reference model in the library, with a step-by-step How do I for each task.

manuals.title: Developer guide: connectors and integrations
manuals.audience: Developers who write ETLs, scripts, connectors and reports against EA Explorer
manuals.purpose: Everything a developer can build against EA Explorer, with examples: authentication, the REST API, push sources and the Python kit, deliveries, OData feeds and sources, webhooks, import formats and MCP.

manuals.title: Disaster recovery guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins and IT Admins responsible for recovery
manuals.purpose: Getting EA Explorer back after a failure: backups or DR and which to use, the DR pack, rebuilding on another machine, the restores from one model to everything, and what to do first in a catastrophe.

chapters.title: The DR pack and the DR tool

manuals.title: Site pairing for hot-standby DR
manuals.audience: Super Admins setting up a second site
manuals.purpose: Pairing two EA Explorer sites so that a DR site is kept read only and up to date with the primary (hot standby), ready to take over; and content sync between sites. Pairing is one way: the DR site takes over with Stop and take over, it does not take changes at the same time as the primary.

chapters.title: Switching to the DR site and back

manuals.title: Emergency guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins and IT Admins, when something urgent has gone wrong
manuals.purpose: What to do when you cannot get in or a secret must change now: resetting an administrator's password, unlocking, removing a lost authenticator, break-glass sign-in, and rotating passwords, keys and certificates.

manuals.title: EAX command guide
manuals.audience: Anyone who runs EA Explorer from the machine
manuals.purpose: The eax command, in full: how it is used, what each group of commands does, and every command with its options and examples, as `eax help` gives them.

chapters.title: The command line and the console

manuals.title: Jenkins guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins and IT Admins who run eax commands from Jenkins
manuals.purpose: Jenkins beside EA Explorer: a pipeline for every eax command and DR tool, run with a click; how to start it, sign in, run a pipeline and look after it.

manuals.title: An example project, end to end
manuals.audience: Architects and Project Admins learning EA Explorer
manuals.purpose: One architecture project followed from start to finish in EA Explorer, using the sample project Protea Claims Transformation 2028 that comes with the demo data: setting it up, the charter, stakeholders and key questions, the ADM phases, gaps and the migration plan, deliverables and sign-off, and finishing.

manuals.title: Guide to testing the installation
manuals.audience: IT Admins and Super Admins checking an installation works
manuals.purpose: Testing an installation from the inside and from outside: the self-test and its suites, watching a test, reading the results, cleaning up, and the test bench.

manuals.title: Guide to testing backup and DR
manuals.audience: Super Admins and IT Admins proving that backups and DR work
manuals.purpose: Proving that backups restore and that DR works, both by hand and with the commands: checking a backup, the restore drill, the monthly drill, the new-machine drill and eax-drill.

manuals.title: Upgrade guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins and IT Admins upgrading EA Explorer
manuals.purpose: Upgrading EA Explorer, either directly from a release on git (Updates, or eax update) or by getting the latest code by hand and upgrading; choosing channels, and rolling an update back.

chapters.title: By hand, from the latest code

manuals.title: Troubleshooting guide for administrators
manuals.audience: IT Admins and Super Admins finding out what is wrong
manuals.purpose: Finding out what is wrong and putting it right: status, logs and diagnostics, health and alerts, failing checks, containers, jobs and the database. Error codes, each with what to do, come in Release 7.9 with their own guide.

chapters.title: The work folder and the logs

manuals.title: AI and MCP user guide
manuals.audience: Everyone who works with EA Explorer through an AI assistant
manuals.purpose: Working with EA Explorer through your AI assistant: connecting it, what it can do for each kind of user, and the MCP server and its tools.

chapters.title: The MCP server and its tools

manuals.title: Setting up Keycloak with your directory or identity provider
manuals.audience: Super Admins and User Admins connecting sign-in to the organisation's directory
manuals.purpose: Signing people in with the organisation's own accounts: Keycloak with Active Directory or LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, Google, or any other OpenID Connect or SAML provider; and mapping directory groups to EA Explorer's roles.

chapters.title: Active Directory or LDAP
sources: page:docs/deployment.md#5. Active Directory groups mapped to roles (D503)

chapters.title: Entra ID, Google and other providers

manuals.title: Security best practice guide
manuals.audience: Super Admins, IT Admins and security reviewers
manuals.purpose: Keeping an EA Explorer installation secure: the hardening checklist, secrets and certificates, who may reach it, multi-factor sign-in, machine access, and reporting a security issue.

chapters.title: Who may reach it and how
